A comprehensive list of specialized scientific training, pre-conference workshops, elective academic coursework, leadership programs, and language certifications.

---

## Advanced Scientific & Technical Training

* **Immunophenotyping of Leukemias by Flow Cytometry** | *June 2025*  
  *Laboratorio Nacional de Citometría de Flujo (LANAFLOW)*  
  Specialized hands-on training covering flow cytometry fundamentals, multi-parametric panel design, gating strategies, and cell immunophenotyping protocols.

* **Pre-Conference Scientific Workshops** | *September 2025*  
  *XXVI National Congress of Immunology* | Chihuahua, Mexico  
  Intensive training sessions focused on advanced immunogenomics and experimental techniques.

## Relevant Advanced Coursework (UNAM)

Selected elective and specialized courses taken during the *Licenciatura en Ciencias Genómicas*:

* **Population Genomics & Human Evolutionary Genetics**
* **Immunogenomics & Single-Cell Transcriptomics**
* **Numerical Methods & Scientific Computing**

## Leadership, Business & Technology

* **Agentforce AI & Cloud Agent Platforms** | *July 2026*  
  *Salesforce / De México a San Francisco Program*  
  Technical training on autonomous AI agent configuration, workflow orchestration, and business applications.

* **Professional & Life Skills Training**  
  Workshops and programs focused on project management, teamwork, and professional communication.

## Language Certifications

* **TOEFL ITP English Proficiency Examination** | *April 2025*  
  *Escuela Nacional de Lenguas, Lingüística y Traducción (ENALLT, UNAM)*  
  Official certification demonstrating advanced proficiency in academic English (listening, structure, and reading comprehension).
